quest.title: The Shooting Range and the Deep Shadow Realm
quest.description: After a battle in the Shadow Realm, the Eye of Graeae informs you that a new function has been unlocked for the shooting range accessible via the train.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: This is a function of the Shadow Realm that has been set up as a shooting range... Once upon a time, (...) and (...) also used this function to train...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: To further simulate the environment within the depths of the Shadow Realm and prepare for deeper delves into it...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Strange. These memories appear to have been erased.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: But anyway, you can use this device to simulate a Shadow Realm, or the more oppressive Deep Shadow Realm...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: You can even complete the training to unlock the corresponding access to blueprints for stronger firearms.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, so we train in here, and then we get the keys to unlock even stronger weapons!

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: That is the case. I applaud your swift understanding. In that case, please follow my instructions...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: The firearms and accessories within the trophy case here are designed for those who have completed Shadow Realm training and Deep Shadow Realm cleansing operations.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so that's how it is!

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: In that case, that's all for the instructions. I recommend that you make preparations when you have time and try the facilities...
